codec.format: sgenaxis.design version1 retained; recognized current-UI fields become explicitly represented after Owner approval; no version auto-upgrade
codec.public_functions: parse_design_json(&str)->Result<DesignDoc,HostError>; serialize_design(&DesignDoc)->Result<String,HostError> unchanged. build_preview_html/save/load APIs unchanged and not upgraded to new persistence semantics.
codec.unknown_policy: Reject unknown members at root/meta/node/guides before a partial typed result. Existing props remains an intentionally open nested JSON data bag; preserve supported values, do not execute strings/keys. No new root extensions bag or plugin runtime.
codec.duplicate_policy: Reject duplicate keys at all levels, including props, with exact RFC6901 pointer. Do not accept duplicate-last-wins parsing as preservation.
codec.optional_policy: For five new fields: absence means None and omitted on serialize; explicit null invalid, including false/0/empty arrays preserved distinctly. Old pre-existing optional/default contracts remain unchanged and explicitly normalized in comparison.
codec.numeric_policy: H1 preserves numeric semantic value, not token formatting. Allow value only when the current HOST JSON representation can serialize/reparse it without decimal-value loss AND any mathematically integral value lies within[-9007199254740991,9007199254740991] for the JS consumer. Accept1.00/1E+03 if canonical decimal value is unchanged; reject9007199254740993, overflow, underflow or precision-losing decimal instead of silently rounding. No floating-point intermediate may be used as proof of decimal equality. Helpers remain private in the single HOST file.

proposed_limits.authority: new M03 recommendations, NOT inherited approval merely because another module uses these values

codec.priority: input size/UTF8/BOM -> grammar/duplicate/resource guards -> format/version -> known/unknown/type checks -> numeric representation -> typed document validate; no current-state mutation or file write before success
codec.existing_errors: Existing malformed JSON/format/version/product_pass=true refusal semantics and readable HostError::Settings remain; no new public HostError variant, no relaxed product_pass guard. New prefixes for newly rejected cases need Owner adoption.
codec.success: Decode fully representable input and serialize/reparse all business fields equal under explicit existing-default + canonical numeric semantics; preserve the five lost field paths and original node IDs/relationships/hints/props. Never silently delete unrepresented data.
codec.failure: Return HostError::Settings and no partial DesignDoc; caller remains responsible for installing a candidate only on full success. Source bytes untouched. This pure codec slice does not claim active-state, atomic file-save, UI, or formal snapshot acceptance.
codec_does_not_decide: root form geometry versus disagreeing formSize UI preference
cross-file graph repairs or identity remaps

preview_authority.source: extends original preview-contract-review proposal; not an adopted runtime design
preview_authority.document_owner: Existing document application owner remains authoritative. Proposed future M03 design/binding representation in WORK and orchestration in HOST/DispatchHost must receive its own exact packet; H1 moves no ownership.
preview_authority.content: Layout, persistent guide/grid/form metadata, declared props/interaction design are content. Their approved mutations advance the document content revision once and are observed by M04/M07 only at completed mutation boundaries.
preview_authority.ephemeral: Selection/focus/playback progress, simulated Viewer control values and navigation are projections. They do not mark document dirty, enter content Undo, advance content revision, or trigger recovery snapshots. Legacy selection/updatedAt wire fields may be preserved for compatibility but are not authority or content-fingerprint input.
preview_authority.Editor: Ordinary click selects a stable-ID item. Explicit authorized property/interaction editing crosses approved application mutation boundary with expected content revision; author-configured behavior is not executed by Editor selection.
preview_authority.Viewer: Explicit mode entry creates detached mock state from an immutable design snapshot. Only allowlisted mock intents; no filesystem/AI/Git/plugin/process/Tauri arbitrary dispatch. Simulated values never write source props or become formal acceptance.
preview_authority.authority_guard: UI-supplied strings do not authenticate owner/session/window. Native application boundary must bind actual sender and current document; M01/S3 context is a dependency, not a second registry created here.

decisions.proposal: v1 explicitly represents five existing UI-owned fields with absence-preserving optional types; one DesignGuides type in HOST. No implicit value clamping/defaulting for new fields.

Reject unknown named/duplicate/unrepresentable content; props remains open data. Numeric canonical-value + JS safe-integer guard and resource limits are new proposals, not inherited approval. New precise error prefixes only after adoption.

First C1 slice is only existing HOST uidesign_doc.rs + new phase1_design_roundtrip.rs; no WORK/Tauri/UI/persistence/preview runtime changes. Owner adoption precedes Skeleton/valid RED; accepted stage then standing automatic implementation.

Editor selects/edits through document owner; Viewer mock state detached; stable-ID/revision/session guard; M04/M07 only observe completed content commits. This direction does not approve an H2 runtime envelope or new owner registry.
